title: Camera
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- camera body -->
  <rect x='14' y='30' width='72' height='50' rx='10' fill='#4A6FA5'/>
  <!-- body top highlight -->
  <rect x='20' y='34' width='60' height='8' rx='4' fill='#6B93C9'/>
  <!-- top bump / viewfinder hump -->
  <rect x='30' y='22' width='22' height='12' rx='4' fill='#5A85BF'/>
  <!-- flash bump -->
  <rect x='60' y='24' width='14' height='8' rx='3' fill='#F2C94C'/>
  <!-- lens outer ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='20' fill='#3B5998'/>
  <!-- lens middle ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='15' fill='#9AD1F5'/>
  <!-- lens inner -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='10' fill='#1A1A50'/>
  <!-- lens highlight -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='51' r='4' fill='#E8F6FF'/>
  <!-- small lens glow -->
  <circle cx='55' cy='60' r='2.5' fill='#9AD1F5'/>
  <!-- shutter button -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='32' r='5' fill='#F2994A'/>
  <!-- shutter button top highlight -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='30.5' r='2' fill='#FFD199'/>
  <!-- red recording dot -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='50' r='3' fill='#FF5A5A'/>
  <!-- grip lines -->
  <rect x='16' y='60' width='4' height='12' rx='2' fill='#6B93C9'/>
  <rect x='16' y='48' width='4' height='8' rx='2' fill='#6B93C9'/>
  <!-- strap loops -->
  <rect x='10' y='38' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#C0D9F0'/>
  <rect x='84' y='38' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#C0D9F0'/>
  <!-- lens sparkle -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
</svg>
